The requested sky change is excluded. Instruction: the starry sky gains three bright blue-white concentric curved trails; the expected result is intensified auroral light across the sky. These thin, regular arcs with bright endpoints poorly implement auroral curtains or diffuse bands, so most of the requested phenomenon is missing. Knowledge: the supplied explanation requires aurora phenomena; the visible trails do not convincingly depict them. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
